registeredAgainst.endpointKind: ngrok free-tier tunnel to local services/gateway

knownGaps.endpointIsEphemeral: The registered --endpoint is an ngrok free-tier URL. It dies when the ngrok process stops, and a fresh `ngrok http 8787` issues a NEW random URL that will NOT match what Bazantic has on file. There is no `baz gateway update` -- the CLI surface is only add/list. Before the actual submission, either (a) deploy services/gateway somewhere persistent (Fly.io, Render, a VPS) and re-register, or (b) get a reserved ngrok subdomain so the URL is stable across restarts.
knownGaps.draftStatus: Registered as draft, not active. Two things have no CLI equivalent and need the Bazantic dashboard: reviewing/setting real per-method prices (every discovered method starts at a default), and flipping status from draft to active. auth-type x402-mpp needs no credential entry, so that step is already done.
knownGaps.mcp404WhileDraft: GET /mcp on the gateway 404s right now. Per Bazantic's own docs this is expected for a draft gateway -- mcp:true in the listing is eligibility, not confirmation a server is deployed and answering. Re-check with tools/list after activation.
